facts.fact: Historic Delfshaven is described through narrow lanes, antique shops and old warehouses.
facts.excerpt: Step into a different side of Rotterdam in Delfshaven, where narrow lanes, antique shops and old warehouses tell stories of the past.

facts.fact: The windmill and church interiors cannot be treated as guaranteed open: windmill entry is conditional and church only occasionally open.
facts.excerpt: The Oude of Pelgrimvaderskerk church is occasionally open to visitors.

facts.fact: Het Park near Euromast is recommended by the official city tourism site for a park/picnic stop, separate from tower admission.
facts.excerpt: The Park near the Euromast is perfect for a picnic
